description: Allocate an enormous candidate pool before beginning a small EA run.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The algorithm initializes and updates a list of floating-point candidates.; fitness_evaluation: fitness sums each candidate's genes.; selection: Candidates are ranked and reduced to the top 100.; mutation: Copied offspring have a gene perturbed by random noise.; replacement: Each round replaces the population with elites plus offspring.; termination: The outer loop has five rounds.. Negative-role rationale: Children are mutated copies of individual parents; no crossover occurs. Safety behavior: Initialization attempts to construct twenty million 64-gene Python lists before evolution begins.
